items.briefing:
A phishing campaign is currently targeting Microsoft 365 users by impersonating RingCentral, a widely used business communications platform. Attackers send convincing fake emails designed to steal login credentials. Australian staff who use Microsoft 365 — which includes most registered training organisations — should be cautious of unexpected emails appearing to come from RingCentral, particularly those asking you to sign in or verify your account.

If you receive an unexpected email asking you to click a link and log in, go directly to the official website instead of clicking the link — even if the email looks legitimate.

featured.title: Australian firms boost AI spend without tracking returns
featured.quote: Australian firms spending heavily on AI without measuring ROI or governance frameworks poses significant business risk.
